title: Odoacer deposes Romulus Augustulus
summary: The Germanic general Odoacer deposed the boy emperor Romulus Augustulus at Ravenna and ruled Italy as king, sending the imperial regalia to Constantinople.
reason: Odoacer's soldiers had been refused land in Italy by Romulus's father Orestes, and they revolted.
significance: It is the traditional date of the fall of the Western Roman Empire.
